sg2-001.front: First three things every time you handle a shotgun?
sg2-001.back: Point it safe. Finger off, outside the guard. Open it and prove it unloaded: ACTS and PROVE. (85%)
sg2-001.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Every handling step starts the same way: 1 point the muzzle in a safe direction, 2 finger off the trigger and outside the guard, 3 check it is unloaded: ACTS and PROVE.">
<rect width="400" height="300" fill="#EEF1EA"/>
<text x="20" y="28" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#1F3D2B">Every step starts here</text>
<rect x="14" y="52" width="372" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#FF6A13" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="42" cy="85" r="18" fill="#FF6A13"/><text x="42" y="92.2" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<text x="72.0" y="80.0" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#1F3D2B" text-anchor="start">Point it safe</text>
<text x="72.0" y="104.0" font-size="14" fill="#17201A" text-anchor="start">Ground or sky. Never at a person.</text>
<rect x="14" y="128" width="372" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1F3D2B" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="42" cy="161" r="18" fill="#FF6A13"/><text x="42" y="168.2" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
<text x="72.0" y="156.0" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#1F3D2B" text-anchor="start">Finger off</text>
<text x="72.0" y="180.0" font-size="14" fill="#17201A" text-anchor="start">Along the side, outside the guard.</text>
<rect x="14" y="204" width="372" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1F3D2B" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="42" cy="237" r="18" fill="#FF6A13"/><text x="42" y="244.2" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
<text x="72.0" y="232.0" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#1F3D2B" text-anchor="start">Check unloaded</text>
<text x="72.0" y="256.0" font-size="14" fill="#17201A" text-anchor="start">Open it. Look. Feel. PROVE it.</text>
<text x="200.0" y="288.0" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#1F3D2B" text-anchor="middle">No step in this course skips these three.</text>
